component.name: LocalRouter
component.summary: Route AI requests across providers, locally

description.p: LocalRouter is a local, OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Point any tool that speaks the OpenAI API at your own machine and LocalRouter routes each request to the provider that fits it best.

ul.li: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of 19 providers
Cost- and latency-aware routing, with per-client rate limits
An MCP gateway for Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code
Request monitoring, logging and spend tracking
Guardrails, secret scanning and prompt caching

description.p: LocalRouter is private by design: there is no telemetry and no analytics, the API binds to localhost by default, and provider credentials stay in your system keyring.
Note: LocalRouter runs MCP servers and coding agents that are installed on your system, so it requests permission to talk to the host.
